findings.message: "#rule" has CSS `transform: scaleX(0)` and a GSAP tween animates scaleX. GSAP will overwrite the full CSS transform, discarding any translateX(-50%) centering or CSS scale value.
findings.fixHint: Remove the transform from CSS and use tl.fromTo('#rule', { xPercent: -50, x: -1000 }, { xPercent: -50, x: 0 }) so GSAP owns the full transform state. tl.fromTo is exempt from this rule.
